mapper.sql: r.risk_id, r.evidence_id, r.source_event_id, r.expert_user_id, p.real_name, r.risk_type, r.severity, r.title, r.summary, r.status, r.reviewer_id, r.reviewer_name, r.review_comment, r.version, r.source_system, r.source_kind, r.occurred_at, r.create_time, r.resolved_time, coalesce(p.credit_score, 100) credit_score
mapper.insert: insert into expert_risk_review (evidence_id, source_event_id, expert_user_id, risk_type, severity, title, summary, status, source_system, source_kind, occurred_at, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{evidenceId}, #{sourceEventId}, #{userId}, #{riskType}, #{severity}, #{title}, #{summary}, 'OPEN', #{sourceSystem}, #{sourceKind}, #{occurredAt}, 0, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select from expert_risk_review r left join expert_profile p on p.user_id = r.expert_user_id where r.risk_id = #{riskId}
select from expert_risk_review r left join expert_profile p on p.user_id = r.expert_user_id where r.risk_id = #{riskId} for update

select from expert_risk_review r left join expert_profile p on p.user_id = r.expert_user_id where r.expert_user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 'ACKNOWLEDGED' order by r.resolved_time desc, r.risk_id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update expert_risk_review set status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, reviewer_name = #{reviewerName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, review_comment = #{comment,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, version = version + 1, resolved_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where risk_id = #{riskId} and status = 'OPEN' and version = #{version}
